name: ConfigHUD
teaser: A simple mod that lets you customise certain parts of the HUD for more immersion and minimal look.
description_html:
Overview

Have you ever wanted to customise which parts of the HUD you want to see and which ones you don’t? Look no further as ConfigHUD will do just that. Nothing more, nothing less!

You have all probably seen the in-game settings which let you choose which parts of the HUD you want to see. This mod simply extends the variety of those options and of course it offers some extra options to disable any text components that you don’t wanna see.

ConfigHUD primarily favours those who want to add more immersion and realism to their gameplay but it can also be used to just add a more minimal look to your HUD. The mod currently lets you disable most individual parts of the HUD components which the in-game Tarkov settings simply doesn’t offer you. If anyone has any suggestions for any changes or more customisation options please don’t hesitate to leave a comment or message me on discord!

Optional Keybinds

The optional keybinds are for users who want to still visually see some of the text components on the HUD but only when they actually need to. If you want to completely disable all the text just ignore the keybinds.

  • Elevation Up - Set this to the keybind you usually use to turn elevation up.
  • Elevation Down - Set this to the keybind you usually use to turn elevation down.
  • Check Ammo - Set this to the keybind you usually use to check ammunition.
  • Check Fire Mode - Set this to the keybind you usually use to check fire mode.
  • Switch Fire Mode - Set this to the keybind you usually use to switch fire mode.
Install

Just extract the content of the zip file in your SPT directory.
